lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
registration-settings: 269 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 257 B, vue-demi 12 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,400 B on the registration-settings page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (40 packages, 253 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
